text:
Oh, absolutely. I find that nothing builds character quite like the sheer audacity of believing that a plastic weight, which costs less than a decent cup of coffee, can replace the fundamental laws of physics and biology. It’s truly revolutionary: why bother with the tedious, sweaty, and frankly unglamorous process of actual exercise when you can just pretend to work out while watching Netflix? It’s the ultimate hack for the modern consumer who wants the aesthetic of a Spartan without the inconvenience of having a pulse.

As for my dental hygiene, I’ve found that the same logic applies. Why waste time on tedious brushing or flossing when you can simply believe hard enough that your teeth are clean? I personally use a high-quality dose of delusion, applied with a toothbrush made of pure optimism. It’s far more effective than any bristle, and it leaves your enamel feeling light, airy, and completely detached from reality.
